baseline.error: Git returned a path or ref that is not valid UTF-8; cannot safely continue.

decision: Rejected before timing: --count=1 silently omits a later non-UTF-8 ref that previously failed strict decoding. Preserve the existing validation/error behavior.
limitations: Real Git packed refs and an intentionally malformed UTF-8 child name in an isolated repository. Correctness gate only; no speed or memory claim.
